newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Project A overnight volume hits new record.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Project A overnight volume hits new record.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said volume in its Project A session rose to a record 18,960 contracts overnight Wednesday.
The record comprised 18,319 financial contracts and 641 agricultural contracts.
The new high eclipsed the previous overnight volume record of 18,708 contracts set November 6 that consisted of 17,863 financial and 845 agricultural contracts.
Project A is the CBOT's after-hours electronic order-entry and matching system, which operates an afternoon and an overnight session. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
